summary_en: 13,700,000 shares (6.0% of pre-cancel S/O) to be cancelled on 2026-08-31. Post-cancel S/O: 214,700,000 shares. Policy-driven: treasury cap set at 5% of issued shares; excess to be cancelled to eliminate future dilution risk.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: TIS Inc. announced on 2026-07-30 that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 13,700,000 treasury shares (common stock) effective 2026-08-31, representing 6.0% of shares outstanding prior to cancellation. These shares were acquired for approximately ¥5.0 billion under the 2026-03-10 board resolution. The cancellation is executed pursuant to Company Law Article 178 and follows the company's stated policy of holding treasury shares at a maximum of 5% of issued shares, with any excess cancelled to eliminate future dilution risk. Post-cancellation, issued shares will total 214,700,000 and treasury holdings will decrease to 3,710,865 shares (1.7% of post-cancel S/O).
